about: Where each @agentcc/client 1.0.1 test file (tests/port/vitest-legacy-client.json) and each @agentcc/react test file at client-patch-source (tests/port/react-vitest-legacy.json, named react/<file>) went. to: port = tests/<same file> in this suite, same test names (scripts/check-test-names.cjs proves it on every run); shim = code the gateway never applied, which stays with its tests in the @agentcc/client 2.0 compatibility package; live = gateway-client/tests/live/, which needs a running gateway. shim_tests sends single tests of a ported file to the shim; added lists tests the port wrote into a ported file; changed records each kept test whose body a numbered intended difference (tests/fixtures/gateway/intended-differences.json) changed.

batch.test.ts.why: batchCompletion / batchCompletionModels: client-side fan-out over the public API; it stays in the 2.0 compatibility package.

benchmark-deep.test.ts.why: Needs a gateway on localhost:8090; it runs from gateway-client/tests/live/, gated by FI_GATEWAY_LIVE_BASE_URL.

benchmark-latency.test.ts.why: Needs a gateway on localhost:8090; it runs from gateway-client/tests/live/, gated by FI_GATEWAY_LIVE_BASE_URL.

benchmark-v3.test.ts.why: Needs a gateway on localhost:8090; it runs from gateway-client/tests/live/, gated by FI_GATEWAY_LIVE_BASE_URL.

budget.test.ts.why: BudgetManager: never wired into requests; budgets are enforced by the gateway; it stays in the 2.0 compatibility package.

changed.AgentCC client > constructs with default: D-21: client.moderations and client.batches are gone (no gateway route); the test asserts they are undefined instead of defined.
changed.AgentCC client > exports version: D-03: VERSION is the @future-agi/sdk version, so the test compares it with typescript/futureagi/package.json (1.0.1 compared it with @agentcc/client 1.0.1).

shim_tests.dryRun > applies modifyParams: D-21: modifyParams is an option of the 2.0 compatibility package only; new AgentCC({ modifyParams }) raises TypeError here (tests/gateway/shim-only.test.ts).

changed.dryRun > includes gateway config headers: D-21: 1.0.1 passed config { cacheConfig: { enabled, ttlSeconds } } (no section of GatewayConfig) and asserted only that headers exist; GatewayConfig now takes cache.{ttl,namespace,force_refresh} only and raises for anything else, so the test sends cache.ttl 300 and asserts x-agentcc-cache-ttl and x-agentcc-config.

e2e-real.test.ts.why: Needs a gateway on localhost:8090; it runs from gateway-client/tests/live/, gated by FI_GATEWAY_LIVE_BASE_URL.

changed.GatewayConfig > gatewayConfigToDict stri: D-21: 1.0.1 built the config from cache.enabled and a fallback section, which now raise TypeError; the undefined value is now a cache field (namespace).

shim_tests.preCallRules integration > blocks reques: D-21: preCallRules is an option of the 2.0 compatibility package only; new AgentCC({ preCallRules }) raises TypeError here (tests/gateway/shim-only.test.ts).

middleware.test.ts.why: createMiddleware / composeMiddlewares and use(): use() pushes middleware that no request ever runs (1.0.1 base-client.ts:25,109,162); the 2.0 compatibility package keeps use() inert and warns once.

models-info.test.ts.why: getModelInfo and the model table: a local copy of about 23 models; frozen as pure functions in the 2.0 compatibility package.

patch-openai.test.ts.why: patchOpenAI; it stays in the 2.0 compatibility package.

pre-call-rules.test.ts.why: evaluatePreCallRules / allowModels / blockModels / requireSessionId; preCallRules is an option of the 2.0 compatibility package only.

resources-batches.test.ts.why: client.batches: the gateway at live-gateway-source serves no /v1/batches route, only the admin /-/batches (server.go:416-433, :558-560); it stays in the 2.0 compatibility package.

resources-moderations.test.ts.why: client.moderations: the gateway at live-gateway-source serves no /v1/moderations route; it stays in the 2.0 compatibility package.

token-encoding.test.ts.why: encode / decode / getEncodingForModel: local tokenizer tables; it stays in the 2.0 compatibility package.

tokens.test.ts.why: tokenCounter / completionCost / trimMessages and the fallback tables: local price and context tables; cost comes from .agentcc.cost; it stays in the 2.0 compatibility package.

changed.useAgentCCChat logic > client.chat.compl: D-18: the test runs in jsdom, a browser page, so its client passes dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true
